title: Hierarchical GTV Estimation: Bridging the Gap between Container-Level Ranking and Item-Level Conversion
abstract: arXiv:2610.32420v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emerging e-commerce platforms, such as live-streaming and Online-to-Offline (O2O) services, inherently operate under a "Container-based" display paradigm. In this setting, a critical granularity mismatch exists: the platform performs ranking and estimation at the container level (e.g., livestream rooms or stores), whereas the actual transactions occur at the item level within these containers. This structural discrepancy complicates Gross Transaction Value (GTV) estimation, introducing unique challenges including high label variance, severe label sparsity, and dynamic item heterogeneity. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework named Hierarchical GTV Estimation (HGE). HGE employs a Hybrid Set-Aware Encoder (HSAE) to model the dynamic composition of items and feature interactions. translated_title: 层级式GTV估计：弥合容器级排序与商品级转化之间的鸿沟
translated_abstract: 新兴电商平台，如直播和线上到线下（O2O）服务，本质上运行在一种“基于容器”的展示范式之下。在这种场景中，存在一个关键的粒度不匹配问题：平台在容器层面（如直播间或店铺）进行排序和估计，而实际交易却发生在这些容器内部的商品层面。这种结构性差异使得成交总额（GTV）的估计变得复杂，并带来了独特的挑战，包括高标签方差、严重的标签稀疏性以及动态的商品异质性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个名为层级式GTV估计的新颖框架。HGE采用混合集合感知编码器来建模商品的动态组成与特征交互。为缓解标签方差问题，我们引入了一种代理标签学习策略，将点击后GTV分解为购买概率、数……
tldr: 针对电商容器级排序与商品级交易之间的粒度不匹配问题，提出层级式GTV估计框架HGE，通过混合集合感知编码器与代理标签学习策略，解决GTV估计中的标签方差、标签稀疏和商品异质性等挑战。
en_tdlr: Proposing a Hierarchical GTV Estimation (HGE) framework with a Hybrid Set-Aware Encoder and a Proxy-Label Learning strategy to bridge the granularity gap between container-level ranking and item-level conversion, addressing label variance, sparsity, and item heterogeneity in GTV estimation.
